info.title: GenImage 224 - 8 Generator Balanced Subsets
info.subtitle: 160K balanced real and AI-generated images
info.description: Balanced GenImage training subset containing 8 generator configurations: SD v1.4, SD v1.5, Wukong, VQDM, BigGAN, Midjourney, ADM, and GLIDE. Each generator contains exactly 10,000 real and 10,000 AI-generated images prepared at 224x224.
